name: Flesh
notes: Bodies, carcasses and meat. Not flammable: setting a creature alight is left to the fire rules (mw-e03.5), not its material. Conducts charge (salty tissue), which lets lightning hurt. Density 1060 kg/m³ (soft tissue), so bodies sink slowly unless their creature def says otherwise. Creatures set their own health, so no hp here. Soft impacts (0.4) and a muffled thump (audio bible §7.2: never wet gore). A body underfoot sounds like the soft dirt surface (-3 dB, the table's offset for it; the only soft set with sounds yet). Soft surface; not a rope-arrow anchor. (mw-e03.31)
